release.buildIdScheme: sha256 over the sorted packages/web build inputs (src/ + public/ + package.json + postcss.config.mjs + next.config.ts), truncated to 16 hex — same sources always produce the same build id

vercelProject.name: payswap-web
vercelProject.deploymentUrlsNote: live — the production alias and the immutable per-deployment URL were verified serving at record time (the alias answered HTTP 200 and /api/health reported this record's build id and commit); deployed through the project's Git integration (the quota-free path)

apiRuntimeSeparation.law: the web surface is a CONSUMER of the authoritative PaySwap API — it holds no financial state of its own
apiRuntimeSeparation.apiRuntimeProjectRole: the existing Vercel project that hosts the authoritative API/runtime — NOT touched by a web release
apiRuntimeSeparation.apiBaseUrlNote: referenced by name only — the value is supplied per environment (production API host for production, preview API host for preview) at deployment time, never stored in git
